sourceData: bundled us-airline-flows BTS On-Time Reporting Carrier snapshot, 2023-07
regionalSelection: top 24 airports inside [-125,25,-105,50] ranked by all-source in+out flight count, stable index tie-break; induced directed arcs

assumptions.capacity: integer monthly scheduled-count value per reported directed airport pair, including cancelled flights; illustrative link budget only, not realized operations or physical capacity; synthetic uniform percentage scaling is hypothetical
assumptions.unit: abstract integral scheduled-link flow unit, not passengers or a ticketed itinerary
assumptions.delayCost: round(max(0, mean departure delay minutes)); early-departure averages cost zero; flow-unit × rounded delay-minute score is a proxy objective, not expected traveler delay
assumptions.balancedTerminals: public prepareGPUNetworkFlowDemands semantics: 24 airports plus virtual source/sink, SEA/PDX supply 500 each, LAX/SAN demand 500 each; virtual gates excluded from mapped edge results
assumptions.routing: graph paths do not model carrier compatibility, flight times, transfer windows, passengers, or synchronized schedules
